GetUserInputs("Apply Arrangement", 1, "Arrangement name (Ghost / Headroom / Identity / Reordered / Shrink / Subset):,extrawidth=200", "") -> true, "Headroom"
ShowMessageBox("Apply Arrangement", 3) -> 7 <<
This Arrangement adjusts the Headroom of 1 region(s):

  Bravo: +4.000s

Headroom is RELATIVE: it moves each region's end from where it is now, so applying this Arrangement a second time moves those ends a second time. Every other part of a Repack can be run repeatedly without changing the result; this cannot.

Each end is rounded to the nearest bar line, so a request under half a bar resolves to no change. The run log records what each one actually resolved to.

Yes    -- repack, and apply the Headroom above.
No     -- repack only, treating every Headroom as zero.
Cancel -- do nothing. Nothing has been written yet.
>>

ShowMessageBox("Apply Arrangement", 0) -> 1 <<
Applied "Headroom": 2 region(s), 0 marker(s), 3 tempo marker(s), 0 envelope point(s) and 2 item(s) moved, 1 cut(s) made.

1 Tempo Anchor(s) were written at region starts (3 of 4 region(s) already had one with the right values), so each region carries its own bar grid regardless of what a Repack puts in front of it.

2 region(s) were PADDED to the next bar line, adding 2.000s of silence inside their bounds -- permanently, and this does not happen again on a later Repack:
  Bravo (+1.000s)
  Delta (+1.000s)

6 automation anchor(s) were written at region bounds, so each region keeps its own automation values instead of inheriting its new neighbour's. They are listed in the run log.

1 region(s) this Arrangement omits, and 3 other piece(s) of material, were PARKED 294.000s later -- beyond the Packed Block, with their internal timing intact. Nothing was deleted; the run log gives the offset, and negating it reverses the parking.

2 piece(s) of material and 1 envelope point(s) touching no region were DISCARDED. They are listed in the run log beside the project; Undo restores them.
>>
